title: Reaction
description: A reaction-time game: wait a random 2-5 seconds for GO, then tap as fast as you can; show your time in ms and your best. Tapping too early is a false start.
prompts: A reaction-time game: wait a random 2-5 seconds for GO, then tap as fast as you can; show your time in ms and your best. Tapping too early is a false start.
Also show your last 3 times on the result screen, and say 'Too slow!' if you took over 1 second.
In the header, show the player's average reaction time in ms next to their best time. Count only valid taps in the average, not false starts.
